title: National Love People Day and one small kindness for tomorrow
dek: National Love People Day is September 30. Here is where it came from, how its founders suggest marking it, and one small kindness to plan tonight.
keywords: ways to show people you care
keyPoints: Lifeline Church in Chicago created National Love People Day in 2017.
Suggested ways to observe it are to volunteer locally, share resources or recognition, and give support.
Tonight, write one specific kind message and send it in the morning.

sources.title: NATIONAL LOVE PEOPLE DAY - September 30, 2026 - National Day Calendar

body: September 30 is National Love People Day. According to National Day Calendar, Lifeline Church in Chicago created it in 2017 to inspire unconditional love as a national event that brings people together. The day also honors the church's founding pastors for their years of service in the Chicago area.

The suggested ways to observe it are practical. Volunteer somewhere local. Share resources, or publicly recognize someone who does good work in your community. Give support in whatever form you can, whether that is company, information or encouragement. The church itself has handed out meals, gifts and winter coats, which is a good reminder that the day is meant to lead to something people can feel.

At one in the morning, the easiest place to start is with the people you already know. Many of us think kind things about a coworker, neighbor or friend and never say them out loud. A specific message tends to mean more than a general one. Telling someone they handled a hard meeting with real patience gives them something to hold on to.
If you want to go a step further, look this week for one local volunteer shift, food drive or coat drive. A library, school or community center is often a good place to ask what help is needed.
Before you fall asleep, choose one person and write down one specific kind sentence you will send them tomorrow morning. Then send it.
